discription: A saw wave synth with an ADSR envelope and a resonant low-pass filter, controlled by frequency and amplitude.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, rq=0.5, lpfFreq=8000; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); sig = Saw.ar(freq); sig = LPF.ar(sig, lpfFreq, rq); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
